artworks.title: Gathering Leaves (Raccoglitrice di foglie)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person walking in a forest setting. The individual is seen from the back, mid-step, holding onto branches for support. Their clothing is a long, striped garment covering them from neck to ankles. The landscape is dense with foliage, suggesting a forested area. The background shows more vegetation and distant landscape contours. The image is in a monochromatic style emphasizing line work.

artworks.title: Patrol (Esplorazione)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a lone mounted figure on horseback moving through a rugged, natural landscape. The image is rendered in a dark, monochromatic palette, emphasizing intricate details through careful linework. The figure sits astride a horse, which is moving forward through dense grasses or reeds. The background is textured with scratch or etched lines, embellished with horizontal clouds in a somber sky. The foreground comprises of dark elements that lend depth to the natural setting. The overall tone of the piece is a mix of mystery and solitude, achieved through the play of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Kids by a Pond
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a herd of goats standing together in a rural setting with a grass and earth texture beneath them. The goats are detailed, with emphasis on their shaggy coats and curving horns. Some goats are standing still while others are moving towards vegetation on the right. The background is sketched with simple lines, suggesting a sky or open landscape. The illustration is monochromatic and uses intricate line work to show texture and detail.

artworks.title: Forest on Lago Maggiore [Foresta sul Lago Maggiore]
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a rural scene with a path or road stretching into the distance. The composition includes a solitary figure walking away from the viewer on the path. The dense foliage of trees arches over the scene, obscuring the high horizon. The intricate etching style uses fine lines to depict textures and depth, showcasing detailed foliage and textured ground. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing the craftsmanship. The trees and path create depth, guiding the viewer's eye through the scene.

artworks.title: Castellammare
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a view from slightly above ground level. The horizon line is situated toward the upper center of the composition, separating the sky from the distant mountains. On the left side, there is a body of water that stretches towards the central part of the scene. Next to the water is a rugged rock formation surrounded by foliage. The right side of the image features ruins of a structure with rough, textured walls. Tiny figures can be seen near the ruins. The technique used includes fine lines and cross-hatching in a monochromatic palette of soft blacks and whites.

artworks.title: Isola Bella
artworks.description: The image depicts a tranquil body of water with hills meeting the sky at the horizon, as seen from a slightly elevated perspective. On the left of the horizon, there is a cluster of buildings or a castle. The brushstrokes are fine and meticulous, suggesting an etching technique. A tall tree with textured bark and sparse leaves is seen on the right. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black and white. In the distance, a few small boats can be seen on the water.

artworks.title: View Taken in London (Vue prise á Londres)
artworks.description: The image shows a bridge dominating the upper portion of the scene. The horizon is unclear due to the perspective and the bridge structure. Buildings and trees can be seen in the distance. The bridge has lattice work and arches. The etching has loose, expressive lines and stippling for texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of brown ink. A figure with an umbrella walks along a path close to the bridge. Other figures and carriages are present in the background. Light and shadow accentuate the bridge's industrial structure.

artworks.title: Indian Summer [L'estate di San Martino]
artworks.description: The image features a man and a woman, both shown from head to toe. The man is seated on the left, leaning forward slightly with his forearms on his knees. He has a receding hairline, short hair, facial hair, and is dressed in a suit with a waistcoat and cravat. The woman is reclining on a sofa, looking towards the man with her body slightly turned to him. She is wearing a bonnet and a long dress. She holds an umbrella or parasol in her right hand. The background shows a plain wall and a textured or patterned floor.

artworks.title: Bosco [Woods]
artworks.description: The image features a dense forest with bare-branched trees dominating the composition. The treetops fill the upper part, leading the eye towards the center. The detailed etching technique creates a textured, shadowy ambiance. The monochromatic palette contrasts the carved lines of the trees, adding to the moody atmosphere.

artworks.title: At Zelata (Alla Zelata)
artworks.medium: monotype in brown on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a low vantage point looking into a wooded or natural area. The horizon is not clearly seen, as there are dense trees and foliage filling much of the scene and extending into the distance. The artwork features soft brushstrokes creating a misty and textured effect blending various elements. The color palette is monochromatic with rich brown tones, enhancing the sepia-like atmosphere. This gives the image a vintage feel and timeless quality. In the distance, details become obscured blending into the shadowy background, adding depth to the artwork.

artworks.title: Un rimprovero [A Reprimand]
artworks.description: The image shows the upper bodies of two elderly individuals, a man and a woman, positioned close together. The man is on the left side, facing slightly to the right, wearing a head covering and a coat with a visible collar over a shirt. His facial features are marked by age. The woman on the right is turned slightly towards the man; she is also wearing a head covering and an attire that wraps around her, with a visible necklace peeking out. Their hands are gesturing, and the man appears to be holding a small object or his coat. The background consists of a dark, oval-shaped area that contrasts with the lighter tone surrounding it.

artworks.title: Landscape [Paesaggio]
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a low horizon, a sky dominated by swirling patterns forming a dense cloud, a tall rock formation to the right, a figure in the foreground, and a bare tree on the left. The palette is mainly grayscale with various tones and cross-hatched etchings, creating a moody atmosphere with contrasts between light and shadow.

artworks.title: Queen Victoria in Mourning
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a group of five individuals in a formal interior setting. A woman sits in the center, looking down at a child. Another woman stands behind her, while two men and a fourth woman are also present. The background includes ornate wallpaper, a marble bust on a pedestal, and various furnishings.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman in a three-quarter body pose. She is seated, with her body angled slightly to the side. She has a calm expression, dark hair styled neatly with waves and a middle part, and wears a light-coloured dress with ruffled or lace details, along with a shawl or additional garment. The background shows a cloudy sky, trees, and hills. The frame is ornate with a burgundy velvet trim.

artworks.title: Portrait of Two Boys
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two young boys seated in a vintage-style portrait. They are sitting on ornate chairs with red upholstery, facing slightly toward the camera. The boy on the left has a round face, dark eyes, and chin-length hair parted in the middle. The boy on the right has a similar hairstyle, but with his hair parted on the side and slightly longer facial features. They are dressed in velvet-like jackets with velvet belts, large collars, and bow ties. The boy on the left is holding papers or illustrations in his lap, and the boy on the right is resting his hands on similar documents. The background is a painted backdrop showing a cloudy sky. The portrait is housed in a framed daguerreotype case.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man and a Girl
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a child captured from the waist up. The man is seated and slightly turned towards the child who is sitting on his lap. The man has short, dark hair, styled to the side, and sideburns. He wears a suit with a dark jacket, waistcoat, white shirt, and a tie. The child has delicate facial features framed by curly hair covered by a bonnet with ruffled edges. The child wears a light, ruffled dress with a checkered shawl or ribbon around the shoulders. The background is plain. The image is bordered by a decorative frame with an ornate floral pattern.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Soldier
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in an ornately carved wooden chair, facing slightly to his left. His right arm is resting on the chair's armrest. The man has a full beard and mustache, with dark hair partially covered by a button-topped cap. He is dressed in a dark suit with a jacket, waistcoat, and shirt. A pocket watch chain is visible on his waistcoat. A handkerchief is tucked into his jacket pocket. The background includes part of a window or mirror frame, with a painted backdrop depicting an outdoor scene. The photograph is framed in gold.

artworks.title: La Font de Saint-Yenne (Blind Critic by an Easel)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Faya Causey in memory of Philip Conisbee

artworks.title: Saint Denis
artworks.medium: graphite on tracing paper, laid down and squared for transfer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Faya Causey in memory of Philip Conisbee
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a male figure standing with one leg slightly forward and both arms raised. In his right hand, he holds a cross. The figure has detailed facial features, including a beard and long hair. The figure is not wearing clothing, except for a partial loincloth. The background is plain paper with faint grid lines.

artworks.title: Ciociara [Peasant Woman of the Campagna]
artworks.description: The image shows the top half of a person in a standing position, with a large container balanced on their head. The person has a focused expression with indistinct facial features due to the sketchy, detailed style of the artwork. Their hair appears to be styled or tied back. They are wearing a dress with puffy sleeves and an apron, depicted in intricate visual textures. The clothing and container are rendered in a way that suggests movement or texture through fine lines. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or other objects being held, apart from the container on their head. The background is abstract and somewhat indistinct, with lines and shading filling the space around the person, creating a textured and atmospheric setting.

artworks.title: Hunting Dogs (Cani di caccia)
artworks.artist: Francesco Colombi Borde after Paolo Sala
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper  [proof before letters]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several dogs in a rustic room. The dogs are gathered around a fireplace with detailed carvings. The room has a stone floor with visible tile work. There is an old wooden chair in the room. Light and shadows are used to create depth and add to the atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Intoxication (Ebbrezza)
artworks.medium: etching with monotype inking on thick wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a reclining figure lying on a surface with a blanket or draped fabric. The person is supine, with one arm extended upwards, holding a cigarette or similar object. The facial features suggest closed eyes and slightly parted lips. The hair appears tousled and falls back. The figure is clothed in a draped garment and seems to be resting. To the left, on a surface, there are bottles and glasses. The background is plain with textural undertones.

artworks.title: Harbor at Capri [Marina di Capri]
artworks.description: The image shows a view of the water from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon line is high, with the sea reaching towards rugged cliffs on the right. In the middle ground, a steamship with a large paddle wheel and funnel is in the center of the water. Small rowboats with figures are scattered across the water, engaged in various activities. The background displays a rocky coastline with cliffs extending from the right, suggesting a sheltered bay or harbor. The artwork uses a monochrome palette of grays and blacks, and detailed etching techniques create texture and depth, notably in the water's surface and the cliffs.

artworks.title: Partie supérieure d’un tableau représentant le sacrifice Egyptien d’une vierge au Nil [The Upper Part of a Painting Representing the Egyptian Sacrifice of a Virgin to the Nile]
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a ceremonial gathering on an elevated platform with water in the foreground. The image shows a group of figures engaged in activities on the platform, which has decorative motifs and hieroglyphic-like patterns on its walls. In the background, there are vague architectural elements. The water reflects the scene above. The drawing style is detailed with fine lines.
